observations.behavior: Defines a parent-child Temporal workflow relationship where the delivery workflow starts after evaluation and uses ParentClosePolicy.ABANDON to continue independently.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes execution boundaries between alerts-product-check-due and alerts-product-deliver; this could support alert scheduling and notification delivery without shared state or dependency on parent completion.

observations.behavior: Adds queue registration for both evaluation and delivery task queues in worker command, including explicit assertions that expected workflows and activities are registered per queue.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides testable configuration and runtime registration of new workers. This supports deployment readiness checks rather than end-to-end behavior.

observations.behavior: Tests that delivery survives parent closure under failure and termination scenarios using time-skipping environment and unsandboxed runner.
observations.posthog_connection: Demonstrates reliability handling: delivery does not depend on parent success. This could prevent lost notifications if evaluation fails mid-run.

observations.limitations: All added workflows use empty inputs and no-op activity bodies; no actual database writes, external calls, or scheduled triggers exist. Tests do not exercise production dependencies or complete lifecycle with real data. No migration or scheduler implementation is present.

review.limitations: All added workflows use empty inputs and no-op activity bodies; no actual database writes, external calls, or scheduled triggers exist. Tests do not exercise production dependencies or complete lifecycle with real data. No migration or scheduler implementation is present.
review.reason: The change adds a bounded capability—parent-child workflow execution and independent delivery—with tests checking the relationship and survival properties. The implementation demonstrates this pattern but lacks broader systemic changes or live-path coverage to support tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Could enable future alert scheduling and notification delivery without shared state or dependency on parent completion. Currently only establishes structure and noop behavior.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on provided chunk; adoption and benefit are unverified.
